title: Multiplayer Fishing Mini-Game
prompt:
Create a multiplayer fishing mini-game using Three.js in a single HTML file. The scene should include:

## Scene Setup
- A perspective camera positioned at (0, 15, 25) looking down at the scene.
- Ambient light (0xffffff, intensity 0.6) and a directional light (0xffffff, intensity 0.8) at position (10, 20, 10).
- A large flat blue plane (60x60) at y=0 representing the water surface. Use MeshStandardMaterial with color 0x2288cc and opacity 0.7, transparent.
- An animated water effect: gently oscillate the water plane's y position between -0.1 and 0.1 using a sine wave.
- Two fishing boats represented as simple box geometries (3x1x1.5) with brown color (0x8B4513). Player 1's boat at (-8, 0.5, 0) and Player 2's boat at (8, 0.5, 0).
- Each boat has a thin cylinder (radius 0.05, height 4) as a fishing rod extending upward and slightly forward.
- Scatter 6 fish beneath the water surface. Each fish is a small elongated sphere (scale 1, 0.4, 0.5) with orange color (0xFF6600), randomly placed at y=-1 to y=-3, within x range [-20,20] and z range [-20,20]. Fish should slowly swim in random directions, changing direction every 2-3 seconds.

## Player Controls
- Player 1 uses WASD keys to move their boat on the xz plane (speed 0.15 per frame). W=forward(-z), S=backward(+z), A=left(-x), D=right(+x).
- Player 2 uses Arrow keys to move their boat similarly.
- Boats are clamped within x:[-25,25] and z:[-25,25].
- Player 1 presses SPACE to cast their fishing line. Player 2 presses ENTER to cast theirs.
- When a player casts, a small sphere (radius 0.2, yellow) drops from the tip of their rod straight down to y=-2 over 0.5 seconds (animate it). The line stays cast for 3 seconds.
- If any fish is within distance 3.0 of the cast point (xz distance) when the line is active, that fish is caught: remove it from the scene, increment that player's score.

## HUD / UI
- Display a HUD using HTML overlay (positioned absolutely on top of the canvas):
  - Top-left: 'Player 1 Score: X' in white text with a semi-transparent dark background.
  - Top-right: 'Player 2 Score: X' in white text with a semi-transparent dark background.
  - Center-top: 'Fish Remaining: N' in yellow text.
- A 'Reset Game' button at the bottom center that resets all fish, scores, and boat positions.

## State Management
Expose the following on window.__3D_STATE__:
- player1Score (number): Player 1's current score, starts at 0.
- player2Score (number): Player 2's current score, starts at 0.
- fishRemaining (number): Number of fish still in the scene, starts at 6.
- player1Casting (boolean): Whether Player 1's line is currently cast.
- player2Casting (boolean): Whether Player 2's line is currently cast.
- player1BoatX (number): Player 1 boat x position.
- player1BoatZ (number): Player 1 boat z position.
- player2BoatX (number): Player 2 boat x position.
- player2BoatZ (number): Player 2 boat z position.
- gameActive (boolean): true when fish remain, false when all caught.

Update window.__3D_STATE__ every frame in the animation loop.
physics_constraints: Boats move on xz plane at water level, clamped to bounds [-25,25]. Fish swim below water surface between y=-1 and y=-3. Fishing line drops to y=-2. Catch detection uses xz distance threshold of 3.0 units.
